summary: Cresco Labs Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 8, 2026, reporting its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026, along with management's discussion and analysis and a news release. This is a routine periodic financial report by a foreign private issuer, filed pursuant to Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16 under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. There are no disclosed special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes. The filing solely covers standard quarterly financial disclosure.
